reviews.title: Amazing A-die
reviews.comment:
I was very pleased with the performance of these DIMMs. Using an Asus Z790 Apex Encore, I was able to boot at 8400 (benchmark stable) and hit a stable 8200 with loose TREFI on the default 1.45 volts. I settled on using a tight, stable ddr8000 with high TREFI and low TFRC for 24/7 use on air.
Like most ddr8000+ from any vendor, I had to play with MC voltage and find the SA sweetspot to get 100% stable, but that's more a product of the memory controller than the DIMMs themselves and so no stars removed. This is very forgiving memory all things considered.
The heatsinks are fully functional and better than most. I have a DIMM waterblock from Alphacool that I ended up not using on these, as I am not getting over 49c during memory stress runs with secondaries set. They look extremely high end as well, and I would have felt bad letting them sit in a tub of paint thinner.
reviews.author: Ferguson

reviews.title: Not Recommended
reviews.comment: I did not find the product lived up to the advertised claims. I am an experienced overclocker and I purchased this with the idea of it being an upgrade to my existing SK Hynix A-Die modules and it was the exact opposite. I was a downgrade and the modules would not even function without error using the default XMP profile. My efforts to tune away the errors through minor changes to voltage and timings did nothing to change the errors. Oddly enough, my original modules pass the same memory tests without error using the saved XMP profile from these modules. Apparently they missed a step in the QC process and sent me a defective kit. Unfortunately, they were unusable for the intended purpose for which they were purchased and could not be used as advertised. They could not even be used as provided, so I returned them for refund.
reviews.author: Mr. Fox
